items.source: Constructs a Quoting with the same String appended in front and end of an identifier.
items.translation: 构建一个引用，在标识符的前后附加相同的字符串。

items.source: Constructs a Quoting with potential different prefix and suffix used for quoting.
items.translation: 构建一个引用结构，该结构可使用不同的前缀和后缀进行引用。

items.source: A conversion from unquoted identifiers to quoted identifiers.
items.translation: 将未加引号的标识符转换为带引号的标识符。

items.source: prefix - a String prefixed before the name for quoting it.
items.translation: prefix - 一个在名称前添加以对其进行引用的字符串。

items.source: suffix - a String suffixed at the end of the name for quoting it.
items.translation: suffix - 一个附加在名称末尾用于引用该名称的字符串。

items.source: quoteCharacter - the value appended at the beginning and the end of a name in order to quote it.
items.translation: quoteCharacter - 用于在名称前后添加以对其进行引用的字符值。
